verdict.rationale: Synonyms are documented first-party: you can create a list of equivalent words to improve relevance. Result curation appears only as a 'Dynamic Search Rules' line on the pricing page ('Boost, pin, or bury results based on the context of each request'), with no docs on how rules are defined or tied to specific queries. 'Bury' means demoting, not hiding. missing for 10: dedicated documentation for pinning/boosting rules keyed to specific queries, an explicit hide/exclude-hit capability, clarity on plan availability, independent or hands-on corroboration of curation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define synonyms and curate results — pin, boost, or hide specific hits for specific queries

citations.quote: If multiple words have an equivalent meaning in your dataset, you can create a list of synonyms. This will make your search results more relevant.
Dynamic Search Rules ... Boost, pin, or bury results based on the context of each request
